text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear anti-driverless thesis from the opening","quality":"position clarity","description":"The essay states its stance immediately and keeps that position unmistakable throughout."},{"evidence":"repeated safety and fault concerns","quality":"relevant support","description":"It backs its claim with multiple concerns drawn from the source, such as safety risks and liability if technology fails."},{"evidence":"'who will pay for all of the damage' / manufacturer blame","quality":"argumentative reasoning","description":"It goes beyond simple opinion by explaining how accidents and responsibility would create real problems."},{"evidence":"paragraph on cars not fully driverless and needing help in traffic","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"It cites a specific weakness from the article and uses it to undermine the case for the technology."},{"evidence":"'If the technology fails and someone is injured...'","quality":"counterargument awareness","description":"It engages directly with a complication in the issue rather than only restating its own view."},{"evidence":"opening, middle, and concluding restatement","quality":"essay organization","description":"It has a more recognizable argumentative structure with an introduction, body support, and a concluding wrap-up."}]}
